title: api-governance gate red on develop: committed api/openapi.json drifted from the routers (BI-PF-0397 EAP endpoints)
body: BI-PF-0397 added POST /api/v1/packaging/eap and GET /api/v1/packaging/eap/validate without regenerating api/openapi.json, so the blocking api-governance gate fails on develop and blocks every PR.

rcca.root_cause: Router changes (BI-PF-0397 EAP endpoints) were merged without regenerating the committed api/openapi.json; the api-governance gate is blocking, so develop is red.
rcca.corrective: Regenerated api/openapi.json with the sanctioned tool (python scripts/dev/api_governance_check.py --write).
rcca.preventive: Run api_governance_check.py --write after any router change; gate already enforces sync.
